repo.name: sglang

detail.body:
## Motivation

Adds the MiniCPM-V 4.7 cookbook page for the model support in #41993.

Merge after #41993 merges and the `openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-*` checkpoints are public on Hugging Face.

## Modifications

- `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-4_7.mdx`: new page. Deploy panel and Playground, model introduction and checkpoint table, configuration tips, the transformers 5.17 remote-code workaround for the FP8/INT4 checkpoints, and per-request `mm_processor_kwargs` (`downsample_mode`, `max_slice_nums`) with measured prompt-token counts.
- `docs/src/snippets/configs/openbmb/minicpm-v-4.7.jsx` and `-benchmarks.jsx`: GB300 cells for 1B (BF16, TP=1) and 35B-A3B (BF16 TP=2, FP8 TP=2, INT4 TP=1), a DSPARK overlay that picks the variant's draft checkpoint, a `qwen3` reasoning-parser opt-in, and GSM8K accuracy rows.
- `docs/docs.json`: page added at the top of the OpenBMB group. The `NEW` tag moves from MiniCPM5-2B to this page, and the OpenBMB vendor card now links here.

## Validation

All recipes were served on 4×GB300 with the #41993 head. GSM8K: sgl-eval, full 1,319 questions, temperature 1.0 / top-p 0.95. Stop rate was 100% on every row.

| Config | GSM8K |
|---|---|
| 1B | 84.08% |
| 1B + DSPARK | 83.70% |
| 35B-A3B (TP=2) | 96.36% |
| 35B-A3B + DSPARK (TP=2) | 96.97% |
| 35B-A3B FP8 (TP=2) | 96.97% |
| 35B-A3B INT4 (TP=1) | 96.97% |

Docs checks: `mint validate` and `mint broken-links` pass, and `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` is OK. In `mint dev`, the page rendered the expected commands for the 1B BF16 cell and for 35B-A3B INT4 + DSPARK.

---

@@ -0,0 +1,202 @@ +--- +title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 +description: "Deploy OpenBMB MiniCPM-V 4.7 with SGLang — 1B dense and 35B-A3B Mixture-of-Experts vision-language models on a hybrid Gated DeltaNet backbone, in BF16, FP8, or INT4, with DSpark speculative decoding on GB300." +tag: NEW +--- + + + OpenBMB publishes the MiniCPM-V 4.7 checkpoints on Hugging Face at release. The repository ids on this page are the release ids. + + +## Deployment + + + + + +MiniCPM-V 4.7 support comes from [sgl-project/sglang#41993](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41993). For all methods and hardware platforms, see the [official SGLang installation guide](../../../docs/get-started/install). The two paths below match the **Python / Docker** toggle in the command panel. + + + + + +```bash Command +git clone https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git +cd sglang +pip install --upgrade pip +pip install -e "python" +``` + +Then run the **Python** output of the command panel below in that environment. + + + + + +```bash Command +docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:dev +``` + +For how to launch the image, see [Install → Method 3: Using Docker](../../../docs/get-started/install#method-3-using-docker). Substitute the inner `sglang serve ...` with what the command generator below produces. + + + + + + + +Pick the variant and quantization to generate the launch command. Each checkpoint has one validated recipe on GB300, plus an optional **DSPARK** speculative-decoding row that loads the matching DSpark draft checkpoint. + +import { Deployment } from "/src/snippets/_deployment.jsx"; +import { config } from "/src/snippets/configs/openbmb/minicpm-v-4.7.jsx"; +import { benchmarks } from "/src/snippets/configs/openbmb/minicpm-v-4.7-benchmarks.jsx"; + + + +## Playground + +The Playground is where you experiment with **SGLang features beyond the recipes above**. The Deploy panel emits this model's validated launch recipes; the Playground lets you turn on additional knobs on top of whichever cell the Deploy panel is currently showing. + +import { Playground } from "/src/snippets/_playground.jsx"; + + + +## 1. Model Introduction + +MiniCPM-V 4.7 is OpenBMB's next MiniCPM-V vision-language model. It pairs a Qwen3.5-style hybrid language backbone — Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers interleaved with full-attention layers — with a vision encoder that slices high-resolution images into tiles and places image tokens with a canvas M-RoPE layout. It comes in a 1B dense size and a 35B-A3B Mixture-of-Experts size, and thinks by default. + +{/* TODO: add the license once the Hugging Face model cards are public. */} + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
CheckpointPrecisionRole on this page
openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1BBF161B dense base, TP=1.
openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3BBF1635B-A3B MoE base, TP=2.
openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-FP8FP8 (compressed-tensors)35B-A3B FP8, TP=2.
openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-INT4INT4 W4A16 (llm-compressor)35B-A3B INT4, TP=1.
openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSparkBF16 draftDraft model for the 1B DSPARK row; not served on its own.
openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSparkBF16 draftDraft model for the 35B-A3B DSPARK row; not served on its own.
+ +**Resources:** [OpenBMB on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/openbmb) · [SGLang model support (#41993)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41993). + +## 2. Configuration Tips + +- Every variant needs `--trust-remote-code` and `--mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer`; both are in every generated command. +- The 1B model runs on one GPU. The 35B-A3B BF16 and FP8 checkpoints use `--tp 2`. +- Serve INT4 at `--tp 1`. The vision tower stays unquantized BF16, and the W4A16 group-128 layout does not divide evenly across the vision layers at TP=2. +- SGLang detects FP8 and INT4 from the checkpoint's `quantization_config`; no `--quantization` flag is needed. +- The **DSPARK** row adds `--speculative-algorithm DSPARK` and `--speculative-draft-model-path` pointing at the variant's DSpark checkpoint. Measured accept length is about 1.1–1.3. DSPARK was validated on the BF16 bases; on FP8 and INT4 the panel marks it unverified. +- Thinking is on by default. Without a reasoning parser, the thinking trace stays in `message.content`. To return it in `message.reasoning_content`, add `--reasoning-parser qwen3` (toggle **Reasoning Parser** in the **Parsers** card of the [Playground](#playground)). +- Image and video requests need no extra server flags. + + + The FP8 and INT4 checkpoints' remote code fails to import on transformers 5.17. `video_processing_minicpmv4_7.py` imports `BASE_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_DOCSTRING` from `transformers.video_processing_utils`, and transformers 5.17 removed that constant. In your local copy of the checkpoint, drop the name from that import and define it in the file instead: + + ```python Example + from transformers.video_processing_utils import BaseVideoProcessor + BASE_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_DOCSTRING = "" + ``` + + The BF16 checkpoints are not affected. + + +## 3. Advanced Usage + +### 3.1 Per-request image processing + +OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions` requests accept `mm_processor_kwargs`, which overrides the image processor for that request only: + +- `downsample_mode`: `"16x"` (default) or `"4x"`. `"4x"` keeps more visual tokens per tile. +- `max_slice_nums`: the maximum number of high-resolution slices. `1` sends the image without slicing. + + + +```python Example +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY") + +IMAGE_URL = "https://www.ilankelman.org/stopsigns/australia.jpg" + +for overrides in ({}, {"downsample_mode": "4x"}, {"max_slice_nums": 1}): + resp = client.chat.completions.create( + model="openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B", + messages=[{ + "role": "user", + "content": [ + {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": IMAGE_URL}}, + {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image in one sentence."}, + ], + }], + extra_body={"mm_processor_kwargs": overrides} if overrides else None, + ) + print(overrides or "default", "prompt_tokens =", resp.usage.prompt_tokens) +``` + + + +Prompt token counts measured on a 1568×448 image with the same text prompt: + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
mm_processor_kwargsPrompt tokens
none ("16x")355
{`{"downsample_mode": "4x"}`}1291
{`{"max_slice_nums": 1}`}93
+ +Overrides do not leak between requests: alternating `"16x"` and `"4x"` on the same image returns the matching token count and a correct answer each time. + +For more API examples, see the [SGLang Basic Usage Guide](/docs/basic_usage/send_request).

+// Single `export const config` literal — no spreads/calls/IIFE (Mintlify re-evals at hydration).
+// Cells are denormalized: no `--nnodes`/`--node-rank`/`--dist-init-addr`/`--host`/`--port` literals — engine injects them.
+//
+// Every cell carries `--mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer` for the GDN
+// hybrid backbone. FP8 / INT4 are 35B-A3B checkpoints only. INT4 stays at TP=1:
+// the bf16 vision tower's W4A16 group-128 divisibility fails at TP=2.
+// DSpark is an overlay; its draft path follows the variant. It was measured on
+// the BF16 bases only, so the quantized cells report it as unverified.
+
+export const config = {
+  modelName: "MiniCPM-V 4.7",
+
+  supportedHardware: ["gb300"],
+
+  matchDims: [
+    { id: "variant", title: "Model Variant", options: [
+      { id: "1b",      label: "1B",      subtitle: "Dense" },
+      { id: "35b-a3b", label: "35B-A3B", subtitle: "MoE" },
+    ] },
+    { id: "quant", title: "Quantization", options: [
+      { id: "bf16", label: "BF16" },
+      { id: "fp8",  label: "FP8",  showWhen: (s) => s.variant === "35b-a3b" },
+      { id: "int4", label: "INT4", showWhen: (s) => s.variant === "35b-a3b" },
+    ] },
+    { id: "nodes", title: "Nodes", options: [
+      { id: "single", label: "Single Node" },
+    ] },
+  ],
+
+  overlayDims: [
+    {
+      id: "spec",
+      title: "Speculative Decoding",
+      default: "none",
+      options: [
+        { id: "none", label: "None" },
+        {
+          id: "dspark", label: "DSPARK",
+          flags: (s) => [
+            "--speculative-algorithm DSPARK",
+            s.variant === "1b"
+              ? "--speculative-draft-model-path openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-DSpark"
+              : "--speculative-draft-model-path openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-DSpark",
+          ],
+        },
+      ],
+    },
+  ],
+
+  modelNames: {
+    "1b|bf16":      "openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B",
+    "35b-a3b|bf16": "openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B",
+    "35b-a3b|fp8":  "openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-FP8",
+    "35b-a3b|int4": "openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-INT4",
+  },
+
+  placeholders: {
+    HOST_IP:   { target: "command", label: "Bind host",         default: "0.0.0.0"  },
+    PORT:      { target: "command", label: "Bind port",         default: "30000"    },
+    HF_TOKEN:  { target: "command", label: "HF token (Docker)", default: "<your-hf-token>" },
+    CURL_HOST: { target: "curl",    label: "Server host",       default: "localhost" },
+    CURL_PORT: { target: "curl",    label: "Server port",       default: "30000"     },
+  },
+
+  curl: `curl http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}}/v1/chat/completions \\
+-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
+-d '{ "model": "{{MODEL_NAME}}", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"https://www.ilankelman.org/stopsigns/australia.jpg"}},{"type":"text","text":"Describe this image in one sentence."}]}] }'`,
+
+  benchmarkCommands: {
+    accuracy: {
+      gsm8k_pct: `# To install sgl-eval: pip install sgl-eval
+sgl-eval run gsm8k \\
+  --base-url http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}}/v1 \\
+  --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95`,
+    },
+  },
+
+  accuracyLabels: [
+    ["gsm8k_pct", "GSM8K", "%"],
+  ],
+
+  dockerImages: {
+    gb300: "lmsysorg/sglang:dev",
+  },
+
+  github: {
+    cookbookModel: "openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B",
+  },
+
+  playgroundFeatures: {
+    attention: {
+      knobs: [
+        { id: "tp", label: "TP", values: [null, 1, 2, 4] },
+      ],
+    },
+
+    // Opt-in: the cells run without a parser, so the thinking trace stays in
+    // `content`; `qwen3` matches the chat template's <think> format.
+    parsers: {
+      items: [
+        { id: "reasoning", label: "Reasoning Parser", flag: "--reasoning-parser qwen3" },
+      ],
+    },
+  },
+
+  cells: [
+    {
+      match: { hw: "gb300", variant: "1b", quant: "bf16", nodes: "single" },
+      verified: true,
+      env: [],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      match: { hw: "gb300", variant: "35b-a3b", quant: "bf16", nodes: "single" },
+      verified: true,
+      env: [],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--tp 2",
+        "--mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      match: { hw: "gb300", variant: "35b-a3b", quant: "fp8", nodes: "single" },
+      verificationStatus: (s) => (s.spec === "dspark" ? "unverified" : "verified"),
+      env: [],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--tp 2",
+        "--mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      match: { hw: "gb300", variant: "35b-a3b", quant: "int4", nodes: "single" },
+      verificationStatus: (s) => (s.spec === "dspark" ? "unverified" : "verified"),
+      env: [],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--tp 1",
+        "--mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+  ],
+};
